description:
## Why
`.agent/docs/fixtures.md` says the `actual.*` files a failing matrix run writes are gitignored. `.gitignore` ignores only `fixtures2/**/*.actual*`, so `fixtures/<stem>.actual.txt` and `.actual.diagnostics` show as untracked, and `git add -A` after a red run commits them (it happened while building fz-nhb.4).

## What changes
`.gitignore` ignores `fixtures/*.actual.*` (one pattern covering every fixture root). Check that nothing tracked matches first.

## Signal
After a failing matrix run, `git status --short fixtures` lists no `actual` files; `git ls-files | grep "\.actual\."` is empty.
title: fixtures/*.actual.* files are ignored by git, as the docs say
